checks.item: IMOB Business Tower: completed 2018, height 145 m, at -8.8122, 13.2361 (documented)
checks.source_opened: https://www.skyscrapercenter.com/building/imob-business-tower/14831 ; https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q17630251 ; https://fcm.pt/projeto/83/0?lang=2 ; OpenStreetMap Nominatim and Overpass
checks.found: CTBUH: Completion 2018; height 145 m; address 'Rua Major Kanhangulo'. Wikidata: 145 m, 35 floors, 2018, no coordinates. FCM (engineers): 35 floors, 'located at Major Kanhangulo Street'. OSM has no building of that name; the stored point equals the centroid Nominatim returns for one segment of the street, which runs at least 450 m (Torre Ambiente is on the same street).

checks.item: 1836: Slave exports declared illegal (Portugal banned the export slave trade in 1836)
checks.found: Timeline: '1836 - Slave trade declared illegal' (Curto 1999). Luanda: 'centre of slave trade to Brazil from c. 1550 to 1836 ... The slave trade was abolished in 1836'. EB1911: 'for over two centuries the chief centre of the slave trade'.
checks.detail: Year and event match. The caption's 'ending the business' follows these sources; none of the pages opened discusses how long illegal shipments continued.

summary: Nine of 10 sampled figures match their sources, including all four Curto and Gervais census totals read from the article PDF. One flag: the IMOB Business Tower pin is a street midpoint and could not be confirmed to within 300 m (year and height are fine); a note was added, nothing else changed.
